Media & Creative

Media & Creative apps for Omarchy

7 packages from the official Omarchy repository.

Reviewed 2026-10-18 · independent editorial guide

Short answer

Install any of these with omarchy pkg add <name>. The list below has all 7 media & creative packages in the official repo as of 2026-10-18.

Every media & creative package

Listed alphabetically. Categories are this site's own grouping; the packages and versions come from pkgs.omarchy.org.

  • cliamp omarchy pkg add cliamp
    Winamp's ghost, reincarnated in your terminal.
  • omacut omarchy pkg add omacut
    Drag two handles, trim your clip, done.
  • omasnap omarchy pkg add omasnap
    A tiny, fast Wayland screenshot tool that turns capture into a full annotation session.
  • schist omarchy pkg add schist
    A Photoshop-fluent layered image editor that's actually open source.
  • schist-bin omarchy pkg add schist-bin
    A Photoshop-fluent layered image editor that's actually open source.
  • spotify omarchy pkg add spotify
    Millions of songs and podcasts, ad-free if you pay for it.
  • tensaku omarchy pkg add tensaku
    Mark up a screenshot with movable arrows, text, and blur, right from your Wayland compositor.
